coordinate_space: Position space, X right / Y down, origin at the feet/action anchor; per-frame pivot_px is that anchor inside the cell (uv top-left relative, y down)

transform_semantics.rotation_direction: positive degrees rotate counterclockwise in y-down image space (PIL rotate(+angle), anchor at image center)
transform_semantics.rotation_anchor_basis: ground-contact fit: minimize max |bottom_y| over all 41 rotated gunner frames (Overturn/Breakfall/Breakfall_Back/gnDodge*/gnRecoveryRoll*), body mask, CCW convention (fighter calibration: CCW err 12.0 vs CW 26.6). Worst residual +76 px comes from the airborne Breakfall tumble frames whose positions were hand-authored; not native-code verified.

weapon_rule.note: rev0000b+c double-attach: both gun layers composite at the body frame index when their atlas frame has content (verify attach_rule: b+c on all WalkShoot* frames, c on attack/stand/reload frames, none on Move/Jump/slide/throw/ knee frames).  Layer z-order gun_c below gun_b follows the reviewed M8-004 deliverable_2_walkshoot preview composition.
